accountId.description: The ID of the account that carried out the operation.

state.description:
The state of the operation.

**Possible values**: See the [Operation states](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Operation-states) table.

errorCode.description:
The error code that is given if the operation fails.

**Possible values**: See the [Operation error codes](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Operation-error-codes) table.

errorDescription.description: The descriptive error message given if the operation fails.

created.description:
"The timestamp when the initial response was created.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

completed.description:
The timestamp when the operation was completed.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

passkey.description: An object that contains information about the passkey for the operation.

user.description: An object that contains information about the ReuseID user for the operation.

rpRedirectUri.description: The URI where you want the ReuseID user's browser to be redirected after the passkey operation is completed.

idpRedirectUri.description: The URI generated by ReuseID, that is used to start the passkey operation in the ReuseID user's browser.

operationProperties.description: An object that contains the configured properties of the operation, which determined how it was carried out.

riskAttributes.description: An object that contains the risk attributes collected for the device.

tags.description: The tags that you added so that the callback events can be filtered.

id.description: The ID of the ReuseID user's passkey.
The ID (`userId`) of the ReuseID user, in a valid UUID format.

externalRef.description: The identifier generated by you, that points to the `userId` generated by ReuseID.

attributes.description: An object that contains the user attributes that were added to the ReuseID user, given as key-value pairs.

sessionTimeout.description: The duration after which the operation will timeout, given in milliseconds.

sessionExpiryTime.description:
The timestamp when the operation expires.

**Format**: `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

userVerification.description:
The passkey user verification that was used.

**Note**: There is no guarantee that the browser handling the authentication uses or acknowledges this parameter.

**Possible values**: See the [Passkey user verification](/apis/reuseid/#section/Common-concepts/Passkey-user-verification) table.

userVerificationRequired.description: A flag that indicates whether a user verification check was carried out during the creation of a passkey.

userPresenceRequired.description: A flag that indicates whether a user presence check was carried out during the creation of a passkey.

requestedUserAttributes.description:
The user attributes to return.

**Possible values**:
- If no value is set, then the user object returned after a successful operation will not include any attributes.
- If a non-existent user attribute is set, then this will be silently ignored.

userAgent.description: The user agent used during the passkey operation
